artwork.visualDescription: Black and cream warped abstract pattern with monochrome bubble icons, plus an optical illusion skull lock screen. Public dashboard preview has no recognizable commercial game imagery.

prerequisites: Homebrew-enabled PS Vita with HENkaku/h-encore/Ensō/HENlo and a theme installer such as Imago or Custom Themes Manager.
No exact firmware minimum or PCH model limitation is published for this theme. Do not invent one.
setup: Extract the theme ZIP into its own folder under ux0:customtheme/, retaining theme.xml and its referenced assets: ux0:customtheme/MINIMAL/theme.xml.
In Imago Library use Square / Add local themes, or select the folder and Add to system themes. Installation requires unsafe homebrew enabled because the system theme database must be updated.
Apply it separately in Settings > Theme & Background > Theme.
